summary: Streaming responses hang mid-completion for LatticeFlow (SSE stalls)
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports streamed chat completions intermittently stop delivering events mid-response. Connection stays open (no error), but no more tokens arrive.

Impact:
Production traffic impacted for LatticeFlow. They have a 60s client-side watchdog and end-users see partial answers.

Environment:
Hosted API, SSE streaming, region us-east.

Steps to reproduce (customer):
1) POST /v1/chat/completions with stream=true
2) Works for ~10-25s then stops emitting data
3) Client waits until watchdog fires

Notes:
Customer wording varies: "hangs", "freezes", "stalls".

Customer examples (redacted):
- request_id: req_9e2c...
- approx time: 2026-02-14 18:12 UTC

Links:
- Gmail thread in Ava Chen mailbox: 20260214-latticeflow-streaming-hangs.json
comments: Ava Chen (2026-02-14): Escalation from LatticeFlow. They say the stream freezes mid-response, no error, socket appears open. Added request_id/time in description.
Connor O'Brien (2026-02-14): Looking at edge proxy + gateway timeouts. Seeing a pattern: long gaps between chunks when backend stalls, proxy may buffer and then stop flushing.

Ethan Park (2026-02-15): Found several requests where upstream (serving) finished, but gateway never flushed final event. Hypothesis: SSE writer stuck when client uses HTTP/2 via certain intermediaries.
Connor O'Brien (2026-02-15): Mitigation: reduced gateway write-buffering for SSE route + added periodic keepalive comment event every 10s. Rolling to us-east first.
Ava Chen (2026-02-16): Customer confirmed improvement after keepalive change. Closing as Resolved; monitoring for 48h.
